snippet.title: Heroes Frontiers Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Heroes Frontiers on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688260/Heroes_Frontiers/

A charming, bustling colony sim in retro pixel art. Carve thriving towns out of an untamed fantasy world. Recruit heroes to defend them or send them questing for fame and loot, and survive a procedurally generated continent full of danger and adventure.
